<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The available tool carbon_nmr_spectra returns the ¹³C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show signals for each distinct carbon environment. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (≈10–30 ppm). By retrieving the spectrum and counting the number of distinct signals in that region, we can infer the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
